board: Common blue/red "ACS712 5A current sensor module" (ACS712ELCTR-05B, screw terminal IP+/IP-, 3-pin header VCC/OUT/GND)
reason: All stages passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring at 5 V, design checks, breadboard, simulator test reading I=2.0A at 2 A, DRC-clean PCB, footprint, LCSC C44471). Model uses the datasheet's ratiometric transfer Vout = VCC/2 + 0.185 V/A x I, giving 1.575-3.425 V over -5..+5 A at VCC = 5 V.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://components101.com/sensors/acs712-current-sensor-module (pinout image ACS712-Current-Sensor-Pinout.png and board photo with silkscreen GND OUT VCC)
